ECHOTIK ANALYTICS SYSTEM — Flowchart Teknikal Gabungan
Apache Airflow 3.2.1 | MySQL tiktok_oltp | Multi-Model ML | Discord Monitoring
PIPELINE 1 — DATA COLLECTION · DAG: echotik_data_collection · Schedule: setiap 12 jam · retries: 1

INPUT: Jadwal Airflow (12 jam) | DAG Params (manual override)
Airflow Variables: ECHOTIK_BEARER_TOKEN, ECHOTIK_COOKIES, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL

[T1] setup_dates
Hitung date range: Library=harian (epoch), Hashtag=mingguan, Selling=bulanan
Auto: kemarin | minggu lalu | bulan lalu | Generate run_id & file_suffix
OUTPUT XCom: dates {library_start/end_epoch, hashtag_time_range, selling_time_range, run_id}

[T2] validate_credentials
Variable.get(ECHOTIK_BEARER_TOKEN) — validasi token tidak kosong/placeholder
Variable.get(ECHOTIK_COOKIES) — opsional, default empty

[T3] fetch_video_library → [T4] fetch_hashtags → [T5] fetch_video_selling [SEQUENTIAL, trigger_rule=all_done]
Endpoint: /api/v1/data/videos | /tags/leaderboard/top-hashtag | /videos/leaderboard/sell-videos
Auth: Bearer token + Regional headers (x-region=ID, x-currency=IDR)
Paginasi: halaman 1–14, per_page=30 | Throttle: 3–10 dtk/halaman, 30–60 dtk antar API

[T6] parser_and_validate [trigger_rule=all_done]
Baca JSON → parse (angka, persen, tanggal, uang) → compute features (viral_score, engagement_tier, duration_bucket)
Validate: required fields + business rules (views/likes/gmv >= 0)

deduplicate_records()
Keep first occurrence per echotik_video_id / echotik_tag_id
OUTPUT: echotik_data_{suffix}.xlsx [4 sheets: video_library | hashtags | video_selling | validation_report]

[T7] dag_complete_summary [trigger_rule=all_done]
Hitung durasi | status: success / partial | Discord: Final DAG Summary + next run time

DATA HAND-OFF: echotik_data_*.xlsx → /raw-data/Excel/
Trigger Pipeline 2: TriggerDagRunOperator ATAU Manual via Airflow UI
PIPELINE 2 — DATA INGESTION · DAG: echotik_data_ingestion · schedule=None (manual/trigger) · retries: 0

AirflowSkipException
"No Excel files to ingest"
Pipeline berhenti (SKIPPED)

[T1] scan_excel_files
Scan /raw-data/Excel/ pola echotik_data_*.xlsx (exclude: processed/, failed/)
Generate run_id | Discord: Ingestion Started + daftar file

[T2] validate_db_connection
Koneksi MySQL via DB_CONNECTION_STRING (Airflow Variable)
EchotikDBHook: pool_size=5, pool_pre_ping=True

[T3] tagging_category_name
Klasifikasi kategori per video dan hashtag pada setiap file Excel
category_name ditulis kembali ke Excel in-place (pd.ExcelWriter, overwrite)

[T4] read_and_load_staging
Baca 3 sheet Excel → standardize columns → add_ingest_metadata(run_id)
build_snapshot_records() → bulk INSERT ke 3 staging tables (batch_size=100, truncate_first=True)

[T5] validate_db_staging
SQL UPDATE is_valid=0: duplicate (keep MIN staging_id) | missing ID/title | missing published_at | views/gmv < 0

is_valid=0
validation_error diisi
(tetap ada di staging, tidak di-upsert)

[T6] upsert_to_production [ATOMIK — urutan FK dependency]
① regions ② influencers (follower_tier) ③ videos_echotik (published_day_of_week, published_hour)
④ video_category_tags ⑤ hashtags_echotik ⑥ video_metrics_snapshot [APPEND ONLY] ⑦ products + video_products

OUTPUT: 8 tabel produksi tiktok_oltp (ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE)
bi_video_revenue_summary + bi_hashtag_revenue_summary [TRUNCATE+INSERT]

[T8] audit_log [all_done]
INSERT ingest_audit_log
(run_id, dur, ins+upd per tipe)

[T9] move_processed_files → [T10] cleanup_staging → [T11] ingest_complete_summary [all_done]
shutil.move Excel → /processed/ | TRUNCATE 3 staging tables | Discord: Final DAG Summary

DATA HAND-OFF: MySQL tiktok_oltp → vw_ml_feature_store (22 fitur) + tracked_accounts + hashtags
Trigger Pipeline 3: Manual via Airflow UI
PIPELINE 3 — ML DAILY INFERENCE · DAG: echotik_ml_daily_inference · schedule=None · timezone: Asia/Jakarta · retries: 1

[T1] notify_start (PythonOperator)
Reset ML_SUMMARY_FILE (hindari carry-over) | Discord: ML Inference Pipeline Started

[T2] check_feature_store (BashOperator — inline Python via ML venv)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vw_ml_feature_store | vw_fact_video_engagement | tracked_accounts WHERE is_active=1
Tulis hasil ke ML_SUMMARY_FILE["feature_check"]

[T3] Inisialisasi MLArtifacts
Load: RF(rf_viral.pkl) + SVM(svm_engagement.pkl) + KMeans(kmeans_content.pkl)
+ LSTM(lstm_forecaster.pt) + HF NLP(nlp_summary/)

Fallback: Gunakan nilai
default/label historis
(0 for viral, low for tier)

[T3] run_ml_inference_script (BashOperator — inference/run_ml_inference.py)
PER USER LOOP → load_user_features() dari vw_ml_feature_store:
① RF: viral_prediction + viral_probability ② SVM: engagement_tier + confidence
③ KMeans: content_cluster (5 cluster) ④ LSTM: 7-day forecast (D+1..D+7)
⑤ HF NLP: summarize top-5 video content ⑥ generate content/schedule/hashtag recommendations
⑦ DELETE existing outputs + INSERT semua (1 transaksi atomik)

[T4] validate_recommendation_output (BashOperator)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_recommendations + hashtag_recommendations + posting_schedule_recommendations
Tulis ke ML_SUMMARY_FILE["recommendation_output"]

[T5] notify_finish (PythonOperator)
Baca ML_SUMMARY_FILE → susun extra_info (feature rows, active accounts, recs count, model version)
Discord: Task Success + total_output | on_failure_callback: notify_failure() per task

OUTPUT: ml_predictions | content_recommendations | posting_schedule_recommendations
hashtag_recommendations | ml_engagement_forecasts | video_category_tags → MySQL tiktok_oltp
